name: Spilling Your Seed
overview: The Scriptures reveal the seriousness with which God regards the responsible use of one's seed, as seen in the account of Onan in Genesis 38. Onan deliberately spilled his seed on the ground to avoid raising offspring for his deceased brother, an act that displeased the Lord and led to his death. This narrative underscores the sanctity of God's design for procreation and the covenantal responsibilities tied to it, reflecting God's holiness and authority over human life and relationships.
